title: Haloumi and Cherry Tomato Pasta
subtitle: with Crispy Capers
description: Want an instant winner for dinner? Brimming with golden pan-fried haloumi, crispy capers and lush cherry tomatoes, this Italian-inspired pasta is just the ticket.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Thinly slice 1 garlic clove. Halve the tomatoes. Halve the olives. Coarsely chop the capers. Cut the haloumi into 5mm-thick slices.
Cook pasta: Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 8-9 mins until al dente. Reserve 80ml (⅓ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta. Return the pasta to the pan.
Fry capers: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a large frypan over high heat. Cook the capers, stirring occasionally, for 1-2 mins until crispy. Remove from the pan with a slotted spoon.

Make sauce: Reduce the heat to medium. Cook the garlic for 30 secs or until fragrant. Add the tomatoes, reserved cooking water, 1 tbs balsamic vinegar, 1 tbs tomato paste and ½ tsp sugar, then season with salt and pepper. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook, covered, for 10 mins or until the tomatoes are softened.

Serve up: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook haloumi for 1 min each side or until golden. Remove from pan. Stir spinach, olives and pasta into tomato sauce and cook for 1 min or until warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide pasta among bowls, top with haloumi, scatter with crispy capers and enjoy.
Make it yours: Bang up the authentic flavour by adding a handful of fresh herbs – try basil or parsley – to the sauce and finish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
